headline: Rashi Peripherals announces cessation of Deloitte Haskins and Sells as joint auditor from Oct 16, 2026
hook: Audit shift may affect Rashi disclosures
summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited filed a notice with the NSE stating that Deloitte Haskins and Sells LLP will cease to be one of its joint statutory auditors effective 16 October 2026. The change is part of routine auditor rotation and compliance requirements. It impacts existing shareholders and potential investors who rely on audited financial statements. Retail investors should note that auditor changes can affect confidence in the company's reporting quality.
why_it_matters: Audit change could influence financial reporting confidence
